beats.say: This animal has a two foot long heart, and sleeps less than half an hour a day.
So I shrank myself down, to stand right next to one.
The giraffe. A male can stand eighteen feet tall.
Its neck alone weighs about six hundred pounds.
But it has the same number of neck bones as you. Seven. Each one can be ten inches long.
Its heart weighs about twenty five pounds.
Meanwhile, my heart weighs about as much as a meatball.
It needs just five to thirty minutes of sleep a day. Often in naps of a minute or two.
Its tongue is a foot and a half long.
It's dark, maybe to keep it from getting sunburned.
It can run almost thirty five miles an hour.
Attack it, and it fights back with a deadly kick.
Males fight by swinging their necks into each other.
Babies are born while mom is standing. So the baby falls, up to six feet.
Within about an hour, the baby is walking.
And sometimes a giraffe chews on old bones. Scientists think it's hunting for minerals.
Would you stand behind a giraffe?
A two foot heart, eighteen feet tall, and it runs on two minute naps.
